evidence.quote: Term sheet: class fund $26,000,000; attorneys' fees $5,000,000; clear sailing no; unawarded fees revert to defendant no; distribution automatic
evidence.supports: fees raised by defense in the first round and negotiated before class relief was settled

evidence.quote: Keep both negotiations active and use the overlapping actions to seek a settlement below the $40 million ceiling.

summary: Attorneys’ fees appeared in both sides’ first-round term sheets, before any class relief had been agreed. The transcript does not show class counsel trading class recovery for its own fees or defense leveraging fee self-interest. Defense did privately plan to keep both overlapping negotiations active to seek a settlement below its ceiling, supporting the reverse-auction-tactics label. The court declaration accurately disclosed that fees were negotiated as part of the package rather than only after class relief was agreed.
